subject: general
question: Which animal was the official mascot of the ICC Cricket World Cup 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Elephant__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won the world cup in 2011.
 
 
• India defeated Sri Lanka in the finals to win the title.
 
• India won the World Cup in 2011 under the captaincy of M.S. Dhoni.
 
• The official Mascot of the ICC world Cup 2011 was Stumpy, the Elephant.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023 will be the 13th edition of the tournament, and it will be held in India in October and November 2023.
 
• The competition will be held fully in India for the first time.
 
• Three earlier events – 1987, 1996, and 2011 – were partially hosted there.
 
• The tournament was originally slated to take place from February 9 through March 26, 2023.
 
• Namibia, along with Zimbabwe and South Africa, will host the Men's Cricket World Cup for the first time in October/November 2027. The event was last held in 2003 in South Africa and Zimbabwe.
